subject: general
question: Virender Singh Pathania, who was in the news recently, has been appointed to which post in December 2021?

options.text: Director General of the Indian Coast Guard
Air Officer in Charge of Personnel

solution:
The correct answer is __**Director General of the Indian Coast Guard.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The New Delhi exemption on Friday assigns Virender Singh Pathania as the new **Director-General of the Indian Coast Guard**. Currently, he is working as Additional Director General, Headquarters (New Delhi).
 
• The Indian Coast Guard (ICG) is the **maritime law enforcement and search and rescue agency of India** with authority over its territorial waters carry its contiguous zone and exclusive economic zone.
 
• The Coast Guard Headquarters (CGHQ) is situated at **New Delhi**.
 
• **Women are elected for the coast guard jobs as officers in general duty only**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Air Marshal Sanjeev Kapoor** has supposed the assignment of Director General (Inspection and Safety) of Indian Air Force at Air HQ New Delhi.
 
• **Air Chief Marshal VR Chaudhari PVSM AVSM VM ADC** was ordered into the fighter stream of the Indian Air Force on 29 Dec 1982.
 
• **Air Officer In Charge** management or AOA, is **a staff role in some air forces, at various organisational levels**.
